value.rationale: The known double Perron pole presents a concrete physical question not answered by the entropy alone: how does initially uniform mass survive, and when does a typical long survivor pass from one maximal component to the other? The all-time exact mass, nonzero n-prefactor, and conditional uniform switching time resolve this directly motivated dynamical discrepancy and are not a mere numerical refinement.
